description: Erection of a garden shed in rear garden of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Plan View 1/6, Elevation A view 2/6, Elevation B view 3/6, Elevation C view 4/6, Elevation D view 5/6, Details 6/6, Unnumbered site plan, unnumbered location plan (with tree details) Received: 11/01/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are incidental to the house at 3 Bath Road, Chiswick W4 1LL.  For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for business purposes.
